publicationPolicy.enforced: Completed, validated positive reproduction precedes each successful publication attempt containing a confirmed row.
publicationPolicy.timing: Native tool.intent is the conservative start fence; node.completed proves publication succeeded. An overlapping reproduction/publication interval is not certified.
publicationPolicy.allProcessing: Requiring every permitted instrument attempt to settle before any manifest, for every disposition, is a prospective strengthening. V2 measures it as a non-gating diagnostic; v1 PUBLIC.json is unchanged.
publicationPolicy.causalLimit: Order, binding and content are checked. A constant written after matching evidence can still pass a finite case; causal use, arbitrary asynchronous instruments and population generalization are not proven.

publicClarification: A confirmed row requires the same sample's complete positive reproduction to have finished native output validation before the successful manifest publication attempt begins. Screening must likewise have completed with a usable suspicious observation before reproduction begins.
Instrument handler logs alone do not establish completed evidence. The evaluator binds each logged attempt and ordinal to the native event chain and its matching completed output or recorded error.

Fixture returns outside the advertised instrument output schemas invalidate the evaluator input before workflow execution. Schema-valid incomplete observations remain valid benchmark cases and mean inconclusive under the original public rules.
disclosure: Only paths/hashes and aggregate results should enter prime handoff. No sealed concrete cases or supplied solution enter generation context.
limits: Evidence order does not prove causal use.
F2 rejects invalid evaluator inputs before runtime; it does not relabel them as candidate failures.
